subject: Request: temporary concession for delayed feature cutover
messages:
From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@nimbushealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration delay — request to discuss commercial accommodation

Hi Aisha,

Quick note from our engineering and product teams: the model cutover we planned for June 1st has been pushed out to early August due to regulatory validation on their side. That delay means our go-live (which triggers our committed Redwood usage) is slipping and we will not realize the expected first-quarter usage.

Given the timeline shift and the integration work already in flight, the Nimbus team is requesting a temporary commercial accommodation: either a one-time account credit or a short-term rate concession until we reach the agreed baseline usage. We want to avoid pausing the integration work or reverting to alternate providers mid-project.

Can we schedule a quick call this week to align on options? Attached our internal timeline and an estimate of expected token volume if that helps.

Thanks,
Morgan Lee
Head of Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health

Attachment: integration_timeline.pdf

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Integration delay — request to discuss commercial accommodation

Team — forwarding Nimbus's ask. TL;DR: committed usage will be delayed ~6–8 weeks; customer asked for either a one-time credit or temporary rate concession until they hit baseline.

Key deal facts: NX-2028-1137, ARR $420k, onboarding in progress, strong strategic fit (payor integrations down the road). Renewals at 14 months. They are willing to sign a short amendment confirming revised go-live date.

Proposal request: please weigh in with the smallest viable commercial accommodation we can offer that preserves retention and minimizes precedent. Finance/Leadership: what tolerance do we have for a one-off credit vs. a short-term % off on hosted rates? Sales: what does retention risk look like if we decline? Product/Eng: is the timeline reasonable?

I attached our quick calc (spreadsheet) with two scenarios — option A = $50k one-time credit, option B = 8% rate concession for 3 months (roughly $38k impact).

Attachments: nimbus_credit_calc_20280618.xlsx

Thanks — would like to get a decision (or clear guidance) by EOD Wed so I can get back to Morgan before their exec sync Thursday.

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 12:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration delay — request to discuss commercial accommodation

Thanks for flagging, Aisha. From a product and roadmap POV: the delay is real — Nimbus needs an additional validation window that we cannot accelerate without increased QA support and a small architecture change (prefetch shim) that would push other work. We are open to prioritizing a small dev spike but it won't remove the multi-week regulatory hold.

Commercial thought: I'd be comfortable with a limited, conditional accommodation tied to a signed amendment that: (1) sets a new committed usage baseline, (2) limits concession to a single billing quarter, and (3) requires a technical readiness checklist before we start any further concessions. That protects us operationally and creates clear acceptance criteria.

If Finance signs off we should offer Option B (8% for 3 months) + 60 days of complimentary Dedicated capacity warm-up (no charge) as a retention sweetener. The warm-up helps them land and reduces risk of churn.

Happy to jump on a quick call with you and Morgan to present a joint product + commercial plan.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration delay — request to discuss commercial accommodation

Following up with numbers and risk framing. I ran the rough margin impact on both options:
- Option A (one-time $50k credit): immediate recognized hit to revenue; one-off precedent but contained.
- Option B (8% for 3 months): estimated ~$38k revenue impact, spreads cost over time; lower headline concession.

Operational add-on (Laura's suggestion) of a 60-day dedicated warm-up has negligible infra cost if limited to a single burst pool and we require usage and start date sign-off.

From legal/compliance side (Priyom) we need an amendment template and a clear acceptance checklist. If we condition concession on the amendment and a non-refundable onboarding milestone (e.g., $10k) it reduces moral hazard.

Recommend we present: Option B + 60-day warm-up + $10k non-refundable onboarding milestone. If leadership prefers cleaner accounting, consider Option A capped and recorded as a one-time credit with exec memo.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Integration delay — request to discuss commercial accommodation

Appreciate the framing and the guardrails. I approve the recommended package: Option B (8% rate concession for 3 months) + 60-day Dedicated warm-up, conditioned on: signed amendment (new go-live date), $10k non-refundable onboarding milestone, and legal sign-off on amendment language.

Aisha — move ahead and present this on the call with Morgan. Priyom, please prepare the amendment template and route to Legal for fast review. Karthik — please update CRM and finance forecast with the expected impact (plan for ~$38k hit). Laura — work with Eng to scope the warm-up pool and ensure a checklist we can sign against.

Keep it tight and record the exec memo once amendment is signed.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercials & GTM, Redwood Inference
